==Instructions==
<code><nowiki>{{Quote|dialogue|attribution|source}}</nowiki></code>

;<code>dialogue</code>: this is where the actual quote text goes. To create a linebreak, use the following formatting: <code><nowiki>''"<br />"''</nowiki></code> For quotes with more than two speakers, use {{Tl|Dialogue}} instead.
;<code>attribution</code>: a short description of the speakers, and additional context if needed. Not followed by a full stop and should only contain links if the subjects cannot be linked elsewhere in the article.
;<code>source</code>: a reference (footnote) formatted the same way as anywhere else in the article. See [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing]] for more help.

For general rules concerning quotations on Wookieepedia, please see the [[Wookieepedia:Manual of Style#Quotes|Manual of Style]].

===Optional parameters===
;<code>|quotestart=0</code>: removes the quotation sign (") from the start of the quote. Formerly <code>|noquote=1</code>.
;<code>|quoteend=0</code>:removes the quotation sign (") from the end of the quote. Formerly <code>|trans=1</code>.
;<code>|translated=1</code>: replaces the standard quotation signs with &laquo; &raquo; for translated quotes. This replaces the {{Tl|Quotetrans}} template.
;<code>|italics=0</code>: removes the italics around the quote
;<code>|formatting=0</code>: removes all formatting from the quote; essentially the same as <code>|quotestart=0|quoteend=0|italics=0</code>
;<code>|audio=AudioFile.flac</code>: adds a link to an audio version of the quote. Do not include the file prefix.

==Example(s)==
Code: <code><nowiki>{{Quote|This is my personal battle cruiser&amp;hellip;and I did not name it the ''Executor'' for nothing!|Darth Vader|<ref name="DM">''[[Doom Mission]]''</ref>}}</nowiki></code>

Result:
{{Quote|This is my personal battle cruiser&hellip;and I did not name it the ''Executor'' for nothing!|Darth Vader|<ref name="DM">''[[Doom Mission]]''</ref>}}

===Two speakers===
Code: <code><nowiki>{{Quote|I'm Ochi of Bestoon!''"<br />"''What the&amp;mdash;?!|Ochi of Bestoon arrives|<ref name="DV15">[[Darth Vader (2020) 15|''Darth Vader'' 15]]</ref>}}</nowiki></code>

Result:
{{Quote|I'm Ochi of Bestoon!''"<br />"''What the&mdash;?!|Ochi of Bestoon arrives|<ref name="DV15">[[Darth Vader (2020) 15|''Darth Vader'' 15]]</ref>}}

===Audio===
Code: <code><nowiki>{{Quote|It's a trap!|Admiral Ackbar|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}</nowiki></code>

Result:
{{Quote|It's a trap!|Admiral Ackbar|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}

{{Quote|[[Battle of Endor|It's a trap!]]|Admiral Ackbar|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
